adapter_boundary.candidate_execution: Each leaf executes a bounded scenario in a UID-10001 child through candidate_client.execute_script.
adapter_boundary.serialization: Only a boolean result or a bounded exception message crosses into the trusted grader.
adapter_boundary.filesystem: Scenarios create child-owned temporary files and close/release mappings before cleanup; trusted code never imports smmap.

risk_adaptation: The native mmap state is exercised inside the candidate child; no native extension, network, subprocess, or external service is required.
